    Determinism after the first hook or cohook letter #

    The unsigned trivial word at a branching vertex may admit two extensions, so global endpoint uniqueness is deliberately not asserted. Once a first hook or cohook letter has been chosen, however, reducedness excludes that same displayed arrow from the opposite-sign tail. The special-biserial degree-two bound then makes the first tail arrow unique.
